# Keyword tokenization record for the flow language.
#
# Every keyword in the language is a SINGLE token under both of the encodings a
# contemporary model is decoded with, EXCEPT FOR RECORDED EXEMPTIONS. A keyword
# that fragments costs the model probability mass at every occurrence and makes
# constrained decoding harder, so the inventory is measured rather than assumed.
#
# AN EXEMPTION PINS THE MEASUREMENT; IT DOES NOT STOP MEASURING. Each exempted
# keyword names its measured counts and the ruling that admitted it, and it still
# pays the fragmentation at every occurrence — the invariant holds with one
# recorded exception rather than not holding.
#
# tokenizer: tiktoken 0.14.0 under python 3.14.3
# encodings: o200k_base, cl100k_base
# measured:  bare and leading-space forms; the after-newline form of every
#            keyword decodes as ['\n', '<keyword>'], so the newline is its own
#            token and the keyword stays atomic.
#
# THE RECORD IS DATA, NOT A HARNESS. No tokenizer dependency is added to this
# module or to CI. TestEveryKeywordHasATokenizationRecord asserts set equality
# between these rows and the keyword table, so a NEW keyword cannot enter the
# language without someone measuring it first — which is exactly the situation
# `checkpoint` and then `func` created, twice.
#
# format: <keyword> o200k_base=<n> cl100k_base=<n>

flow o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
note o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
import o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
state o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
var o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
const o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
param o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
on o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
source o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
transform o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
branch o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
switch o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
tee o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
sink o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
drop o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
loop o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
send o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
use o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
from o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
over o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
reads o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
writes o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
clone o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
else o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
checkpoint o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
idempotent o200k_base=3 cl100k_base=3
func o200k_base=1 cl100k_base=1
